about: Slay your way in Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree, a dark fantasy action RPG. Battle monsters, craft powerful upgrades for your weapons and gear, and explore the secrets of this vast, ruined world.
You are an Inquisitor. As evil seeps into Faelduum through tears in reality, defy your purpose and embark on a path that leads to this world’s unraveling fate.
From the towering majesty of Crimson City, through festering darkness, and into the horrors of Entropy... what will you become at journey’s end?
Choose from six unique Classes and wield blades and magic to master your craft in brutal battles. Dodge, parry, and strike with perfect timing to hunt vicious creatures and nightmarish bosses.
summary: SUCCUMB TO A DARK FANTASY WORLD
